run_materials_rfm_training: run the MaterialsRFM model training loop with Hydra config and PyTorch Lightning trainer
build_callbacks_for_training: build a list of PyTorch Lightning callbacks including EarlyStopping, ModelCheckpoint, and LearningRateMonitor from config
run_hydra_main_entry: run the Hydra main entry point to start training with the default config from conf directory
test_model_with_checkpoint: test the trained MaterialsRFM model using the best or last checkpoint via trainer.test
review_run_function: review the run function that instantiates datamodule, model, callbacks, WandbLogger, and trainer for training
